The entire structure (first war, second dissolution, third separation) maps cosmic process onto cosmic process with no contemporary application, no institutional content, no exhortation, and no citations. The only non-substrate material is the brief dialogue frame attribution in P1. The exhortation that Gardner mentions (exhorting the faithful despite persecution) is not present in the surviving text as given — it may have been in a lost section or may refer to the broader chapter context not included here. The oldest teaching layer is overwhelmingly dominant.
